exercise.instruction: Define interface Drawable with a single method declaration void draw();. Define class Circle implements Drawable whose public void draw() prints "Drawing circle". In main, create a Circle with new Circle(), call draw() on it, and it must print "Drawing circle".
hints: Hint 2: class Circle implements Drawable { public void draw() { System.out.println("Drawing circle"); } }
Hint 3: In main: Drawable shape = new Circle(); shape.draw();
